title: Unbounded scalar/open counit identity
statement: For any commutative coefficient rings and any open immersion, the normalized scalar extension, open extension, tensor pullback comparison, and open adjunction counits satisfy the unbounded scalar/open counit equation of [lem-coef-open-scalar-adjunction-counit].

source.place: Proof paragraph 3, steps 4–7: normalized scalar/open mate and counit calculation on the unbounded derived category.

proof.text: Compose the normalized scalar and open adjunctions, identify their right adjoints, use the open unit formula for the inverse comparison, and reduce the desired equality by naturality and the open triangle identity.
